item.description:
**Download:** [Leise-2.1.35.zip](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise/releases/download/v2.1.35/Leise-2.1.35.zip) — quit Leise, then replace the old `Leise.app` in your Applications folder with this one. (macOS will ask once about "Open Anyway" — same walkthrough as the first install: [README](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise#readme).)
## What changed in 2.1.35
- **The introduction step can no longer get silently stuck.** If your first dictation fails — for example because another app is holding the microphone — the card now tells you why, in your interface language, and how to retry, instead of sitting there forever. Empty or silent recordings are now reported as a clear "didn't hear anything — check whether another app holds the microphone" message, not as an internal engine error. (Found by a tester within hours of installing — thank you.) - **Recordings are kept for 7 days by default — and the app now says so.** 2.1.34 kept every recording (up to 2 GB) without telling anyone. Settings → Audio now has a "Recordings" section: keep the last N days (default 7) or turn keeping off entirely, with the current count and disk usage shown. Keeping recordings exists so a bad transcript can be re-run from its audio — that re-run action ships in the next update. On first launch after upgrading, Leise asks once what to do with the recordings 2.1.34 already kept. Recordings never leave your Mac. - **Doubled sentences fixed.** Two independent causes of a sentence appearing twice in your text field are gone, and a sentence the polisher leaves unchanged is now kept as-is instead of being retyped. Long dictations into self-resizing web input fields (certain chat apps) get their polish applied instead of silently skipped. - **A guard against two copies of Leise.** If you start Leise from Downloads instead of the Applications folder, or an older copy still exists elsewhere on your Mac, it tells you where and offers a one-click fix. It never deletes anything on its own — moving the old copy to the Trash is your click. - **Smaller fixes:** the learn-word banner now appears next to the field you just corrected; dates and numbers written as words no longer get stuck half-converted ("7 月一日" → "7月1日"-style failures); and several under-the-hood quality gates so a release that got worse at recognition cannot be packed.
## The essentials (unchanged from 2.1.34)
**Apple Silicon only** (M1 or newer) · **macOS 14.4+** · about **7 GB free disk** (523 MB app + 5.9 GB speech models downloaded on first run).
A 100 % local dictation app for macOS. Your audio and your transcripts never leave your Mac; it works with the network off.
**macOS will refuse to open it once.** Leise is signed but not notarised. ⛔ **In both dialogs the blue default button is "Move to Trash"** — pressing Return deletes the app you just downloaded. Click **Done**, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, find the line about Leise, and click **Open Anyway**. Full walkthrough in English, Deutsch and 简体中文: [README](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise#readme).
**What it sends over the network.** Nothing about you. Exactly two requests, both under your control: downloading the speech models on first run, and — only if you tick the box, which ships unticked — asking for a version number.
Anything wrong: **Settings → General → Diagnostics → Export Diagnostics** writes a file to your Downloads folder. Send it over.
